comments.author: @pipoo1
comments.text: The key points to note about the UK version is that the actors who play Captain, Fanny, Pat, Julian, Thomas and Robin are the co-creators and writers of every episode. They’ve known and worked together for years they know every character inside out. The Captain is based on the teachers Ben Willbond encountered at his military oriented boarding school as a child for example. In addition the entire series is filmed on location, there’s no sets used, and the BBC had enough faith from the outset to allow them to film it in a period drama style with a suitable budget to pull it off. It just all adds to a wholly different feel, even if the premise and essential elements are the same.
